description: Organization lacks a process for regularly testing, assessing, and evaluating the effectiveness of technical and organizational security measures. Regular security testing is essential to identify vulnerabilities and ensure ongoing protection of personal data.
applicability: Applicable to all personal data processing systems and security controls. Includes penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, security audits, code reviews, disaster recovery testing, and ongoing security assessments.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through security program review and documentation analysis. Look for absence of security testing schedule, no penetration testing reports, missing vulnerability scans, no security audit trail, lack of code security reviews, untested incident response plans, and no evidence of security assessments. Review whether findings from testing are tracked and remediated.

sources.title: EDPB Guidelines on Security of Processing
